headline:
Behind the aircraft.
A world of parts.
scene: A close editorial photograph of a generic civilian aircraft wing and jet-engine intake seen from the side of a working hangar. Focus on interesting curves of actual-looking metal and rivet textures, believable fan blades partly visible, ordinary soft daylight, mildly worn industrial floor. Cropped like a thoughtful aviation magazine photograph, no people, no cinematic cloudscape. Neutral silver and gray with small subdued green workshop accents. The photograph fills upper 78%.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Instagram sponsored-feed ad creative, PORTRAIT 4:5, ideally 1440x1800 pixels. Brand is Saif Industries LLC, a family-owned aerospace parts SOURCING AND SUPPLY business, not an aircraft manufacturer or airline. Eye-catching naturally photographed aerospace subject, authentic professional industrial editorial design, believable ordinary materials and lighting. Avoid obvious AI aesthetics: no CGI sheen, glowing graphics, floating parts, overly perfect symmetry, fantasy engines, exaggerated green filter, or fake engineering annotations. Keep important content comfortably inside margins. The lower 22% is a warm off-white band containing restrained left-aligned human-style sans-serif typography, thin forest-green #196633 rule, charcoal headline and green small brand name. Not a text-heavy poster. Brand text exactly 'Saif Industries LLC'. Footer 'saifindustries.com'. Small legible disclosure 'AI CONCEPT / STUDENT PROJECT'. No real aircraft maker or airline logos, certification badges, NASA, inventory guarantees or delivery promises. No Instagram interface, device frame, buttons, hashtags, or social icons in the image; those belong in the separate feed preview. Do not imply this is actual SAIF inventory or facilities. headline:
Have a part number?
Start with SAIF.
scene: Natural macro editorial photograph of one generic aerospace-style metal connector with a blue identification band, a simple machined bracket, two precision fasteners and a plain paper inventory tag, resting naturally in a shallow matte forest-green parts tray on a lightly worn workbench. Believable geometries, real-looking brushed metal and kraft paper, soft directional daylight from a nearby window. Simple tactile details, moderate depth of field, no people or hands. Nothing floating, no perfect repeated arrays. Photograph fills upper 78%.
